rationale: All patch-triage findings resolved in fix-up commit 6cb473fba. CR-003: messages.copy() now unconditional in nested fan-out, eliminating cross-branch guardrail bypass. CR-004: outer_iteration_node_number and outer_total_iterations reducers changed to unconditional last-write-wins, allowing None-writes from non-nested continue_iteration to clear the fields. CR-002 (decision_needed): decision taken to accept option (b) — 2-level nesting is the documented scope; no depth-3 guard added. No new blocking issues in the fix-up diff. 1 deferred finding (CR-001) not re-checked per policy.

finding_status.notes: Fix-up commit 6cb473fba removes the `if not is_in_iteration else messages` conditional on MESSAGES_VARIABLE and replaces it with unconditional `messages.copy()`. The shared-reference aliasing that allowed _apply_node_input_guardrails to stamp GUARDRAIL_CHECKED_FLAG on the message object visible to all sibling branches is eliminated. Fix is scoped exactly to the reported line in continue_iteration; no unrelated changes.

Fix-up commit 6cb473fba changes the reducers for outer_iteration_node_number and outer_total_iterations in AgentMessages from `lambda left, right: right if right is not None else left` to `lambda left, right: right`. None-writes from non-nested continue_iteration (is_in_iteration=False) now correctly clear the OUTER_* fields instead of being silently discarded. Fields iteration_node_number and total_iterations retain the right-wins-unless-None reducer — intentional and unchanged.

Decision taken: option (b) — accept silent behavior as documented. The spec explicitly scopes this feature to 2-level nesting; depth-3+ is out of scope for this PR. No guard, assertion, or warning was added. The concern is moot within the stated scope boundary. Deferred to a future ticket if 3-level support is ever required.
